_doc: Single source of truth for external runtime dependencies. Used by tools/build-importmaps.mjs and tools/vendor.mjs. The CDN major-version pin should match the major version that npm install actually resolves into node_modules; otherwise CDN mode and offline mode behave differently. List entries even for deps used by components that aren't yet in web/sol-full.js — the importmap covers them so the offline page won't 404 when a component is added. All-ESM: vendor.mjs emits one ESM file per dep (`<flat-name>.js`); the importmap binds the bare specifier to it, so every module shares one instance. No UMD outputs — the `<script>`-tag drop-in path is retired. Comunica is on jsDelivr `+esm` because esm.sh cannot build it — every target/flag combination throws at evaluation.
